Each data file passes schema validation against the approved extract template.

critical_path.dependency: Data Ingestion and Validation → Ratio and Curve Analysis
critical_path.description: Without validated, unit-labeled data, no analysis can proceed. This is a hard dependency because the process halts if validation fails.

critical_path.dependency: Ratio and Curve Analysis → Verdict Assignment and Risk Classification
critical_path.description: Verdicts require fully processed ratios and curves; any missing or mislabeled input will prevent verdict assignment.

critical_path.dependency: Verdict Assignment and Risk Classification → Reconciliation and Final Output Generation
critical_path.description: Final output must be built only after all verdicts are assigned with justification and reconciliation is complete.

risk_register.description: A column contains both percentages and basis points without explicit labeling. This violates the unit discipline rule and will cause review tooling failure.
risk_register.mitigation: All numeric columns must be labeled with units (e.g., 'chargeback_ratio_percent', 'reserve_floor_bps'). Any column without a label is flagged for rejection before processing begins.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Unit labeling validation log shows at least one unlabelled or mixed-unit column.
risk_register.audit_hook: The unit sanitization report must include a count of all columns with missing or inconsistent units; this check runs on every ingestion cycle.

risk_register.description: Appetite statements for any portfolio segment are not available in the required format (e.g., threshold, unit, rule ID). This prevents verdict assignment.
risk_register.mitigation: The appetite statement must be provided by the governance team before phase 3 begins. If missing, workstream is blocked until received.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Verdict engine fails to find appetite thresholds for any segment in the input data.
risk_register.audit_hook: A check exists in the verdict engine that validates presence of appetite thresholds per segment; this runs at entry to phase 3.

risk_register.description: Scheme network rules are not available or not mapped to specific segments. This prevents accurate ratio and curve analysis.
risk_register.mitigation: Rules must be provided in a structured format (rule ID, threshold, unit) before phase 2 begins. Missing rules block the workstream.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Decline curve or chargeback ratio analysis fails to apply scheme thresholds due to missing rule mapping.
risk_register.audit_hook: The decline curve analysis script includes a rule lookup check that halts if no matching rule exists for any bin range.

risk_register.description: Component totals do not match overall portfolio sums (e.g., sum of chargeback ratios ≠ total portfolio ratio). This is a hard error and must be caught early.
risk_register.mitigation: All reconciliation checks are performed at the end of each workstream. Mismatches trigger an immediate halt and diagnostic output.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Reconciliation summary shows a mismatch between component sum and total value (e.g., 0.31% + ... = 1.25%, but portfolio total is 1.02%).
risk_register.audit_hook: The reconciliation check runs in the final workstream and logs all mismatches with diagnostic output.

document.notes: This plan is scoped strictly to quarterly exposure review of card portfolio risk. It does not include: (1) fraud modeling, (2) credit risk assessment, (3) macroeconomic scenario analysis, or (4) customer segmentation beyond the 9 portfolio segments provided. The process assumes all raw data inputs are complete and correctly formatted as per SCHEMA-EXTRACTS-Q4. Any input that cannot be classified (e.g., missing segment ID, invalid unit) will trigger a diagnostic halt with an error message naming the offending input. All rounding is to two decimal places; no rounding occurs in intermediate steps. The output artifact must contain explicit units on all numeric columns and use only the fixed verdict vocabulary: within-appetite, watch, breach-imminent, breach. Repeated execution of this plan will converge to the same artifact due to deterministic data processing rules and defined dependencies. All workstreams are owned by a single individual; no shared ownership is permitted. The critical path is derived from hard dependencies only. A slip threshold of 48 hours in any phase triggers recomputation of the critical path.
